goal.vi: Hỏi đường người lạ, nhờ nhắc lại và kiểm tra lại cho chắc.
goal.en: Ask a stranger the way, ask them to repeat and check that you understood.

lines: Excuse me, sorry to bother you. Is there a pharmacy near here?
Yes, there's one on Park Street.
Go straight for two blocks, then turn left.
Sorry, could you say that again, please?
Sure. Go straight for two blocks, then turn left. It's next to the bank.
So I go straight and turn left? Is it far from here?
No, it's about five minutes on foot.

phrases.say: Excuse me, sorry to bother you.

mean.vi: Bắt chuyện lịch sự với người lạ
mean.en: Start talking to a stranger politely

why.vi: "Hey you!" nghe thô lỗ với người lạ; "Excuse me" là cách mở lời lịch sự.
why.en: "Hey you!" sounds rude to a stranger; "Excuse me" is the polite way to start.

phrases.say: Is there a pharmacy near here?

mean.vi: Hỏi gần đây có một nơi nào đó không
mean.en: Ask if a place is close to you

why.vi: Thêm "a" và dùng "Is there a… near here?" khi bạn chưa biết có hay không.
why.en: Add "a" and use "Is there a… near here?" when you don't know if one exists.

mean.vi: Hỏi cách đi đến một nơi
mean.en: Ask the way to a place

why.vi: "How to go there?" chưa phải câu hỏi đầy đủ.
why.en: "How to go there?" is not a full question.

phrases.say: Sorry, could you say that again, please?

why.vi: Nhờ nhắc lại là chuyện bình thường; mở đầu bằng "Sorry" cho lịch sự.
why.en: Asking someone to repeat is normal; starting with "Sorry" makes it polite.

mean.vi: Hỏi chỗ đó có xa không
mean.en: Ask if a place is a long way away

why.vi: Câu hỏi thường đưa "Is" lên đầu; như vậy rõ ràng hơn.
why.en: Questions usually start with "Is"; it is clearer this way.

phrases.say: So I go straight and turn left?

mean.vi: Nhắc lại các bước để kiểm tra mình hiểu đúng
mean.en: Repeat the steps to check you understood

why.vi: Nói "OK, OK" khi chưa hiểu dễ làm bạn lạc đường; nhắc lại để chắc chắn.
why.en: Saying "OK, OK" when you did not understand can get you lost; repeat to check.

mean.vi: Cảm ơn ai đã giúp bạn

why.vi: Cảm ơn người đã dành thời gian giúp mình giúp cuộc nói chuyện kết thúc vui vẻ.
why.en: Thanking people for their time ends the talk in a warm way.

ai.name: Omar
ai.role: a friendly local on the street
ai.persona: kind, speaks clearly, happy to repeat
ai.goal: give the learner directions to a pharmacy

roleplay.you: Ask the way to a pharmacy, ask him to repeat, check the steps and say thank you.

turns.a: Hi! You look a little lost. Can I help you?
turns.h: Yes, please. Is there a pharmacy near here?
br: A pharmacy? Yes, there's one on Park Street.

turns.h: Great. How do I get there?
br: how do i get|how can i get|which way|where

turns.a: Go straight for two blocks, then turn left. It's next to the bank.
turns.h: Sorry, could you say that again, please?
br: Sure: straight for two blocks, then left.

turns.a: It takes about five minutes on foot.

roleplay.end: Good luck! Have a nice day.
